name: bg-compact
description: Pre-computes a summary before the auto-compact limit so the compaction is that summary plus every message after it.

preCompactRatio.title: Pre-compaction ratio
preCompactRatio.description: Fraction of the auto-compact limit at which a turn end forks the first summary. Between 0 and 1.

extendRatio.title: Extend ratio
extendRatio.description: Fraction of the auto-compact limit the tokens after the stored summary may reach before a turn end forks an extended summary. Between 0 and 1.
